scope: Implement the PAR-126 model relation between block-cell ATTDEF overrides and their owning cell-content ordinal while retaining the narrow output profile.

method.kind: Local model/parser/writer implementation with generated AC1021, AC1024, ASCII DXF and binary DXF controls

localTests.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4

method.evidenceRule: Generated vectors verify local parser model association and fail-closed writer admission only; they are not producer interoperability, independent semantics, or complete TABLE support evidence.

implementation.model: DRW_TableCellAttribute now has m_contentIndex in addition to m_index; m_index remains the ATTDEF tuple ordinal.
implementation.dwgParser: parseTableCell stores the enclosing content-loop ordinal with each ATTDEF tuple.
implementation.dxfParser: The ACAD_TABLE group-179 attribute count captures the current cell-content slot; group-331 tuples retain the slot, and attributes from multiple contents are accumulated instead of clearing prior tuples. If no content exists, the parser uses UINT32_MAX and marks the snapshot incomplete.
implementation.writerBoundary: The current one-content DXF TABLE writer and dwg2dxf adapter preflight require m_contentIndex == 0 for emitted block-cell attributes.
implementation.compatibility: Public DRW_TableCellAttribute layout changed; downstream consumers must rebuild. No DRW_Interface virtual was added.

controls.payload: One scalar value content followed by a block content in slot 1 with one ATTDEF tuple (ATTDEF index 0).
assertions: Content order and block handle are retained.
The ATTDEF tuple retains m_contentIndex=1 separately from m_index=0.
Existing one-content attribute control retains default m_contentIndex=0 and copy preserves it.

controls.payload: Generated two-content cell with an ATTDEF-bearing later block content.
assertions: The validated TABLE prefix is retained.
The incomplete semantic grid remains unpublished and the committed cursor remains at TABLECONTENT start.
controls.limitation: Inline content is intentionally not published when any cell attribute is present, so this vector does not directly inspect m_contentIndex.

controls.route: ACAD_TABLE DXF ASCII and binary parsers
controls.payload: Cell value content in slot 0 followed by block content in slot 1 with a single ATTDEF override.
assertions: Both encodings retain the two content records in order.
The ATTDEF handle/text remain associated with m_contentIndex=1 and m_index=0.

controls.payload: ATTDEF group 179/331 appears before any cell content has been established.
assertions: The table is marked semantically incomplete.
The retained tuple uses UINT32_MAX for an unassociated content slot rather than defaulting to slot zero.

controls.route: ASCII and binary DXF TABLE writer preflight
assertions: A one-content block cell with a nonzero content index is refused before output publication.
The existing single-content content-index-zero attribute route remains readable and writable.

doesNotEstablish: the semantic interpretation of the ODA ATTDEF index beyond preserving it independently from content position
AC1024 inline public semantic retention of attribute-bearing grids
DATALINK object dispatch, ownership, range consistency, or external spreadsheet refresh
native CAD behavior or all-version TABLE parity

planImpact.nextSlice: Producer-backed TABLECONTENT/DATALINK owner, linked-range metadata and reference census; then atomic DATALINK object routing.
